snippet.title: Off-Road: Redneck Racing - 2024 Re-Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Off-Road: Redneck Racing is an exclusive ZOOM Platform re-release and, as a bonus, includes the original Off-Road! The game also comes with the Manual, a Box Art Scan and a Magazine Ad Scan!

First made available on ZOOM Platform in 2021, and, as of 2024, on Steam:

https://www.zoom-platform.com/product/off-road-redneck-racing-double-pack

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2742010/OffRoad_Redneck_Racing/

Off-Road & Off-Road: Redneck Racing Double Pack contains BOTH Off-Road and Off-Road: Redneck Racing.

Both are explosive fun arcade-style racing and Redneck Racing features the Redneck Rampage characters as commentators. Sixteen different vehicles, twenty-four tracks, and six completely unique locations. Pedal to the metal, you'll have a blast!

Yeeha! Stop yer grinnin' and drop yer linen, cause the slam-bangin'est, mud-flappin'est, rip-roarin'est off-road racing game ever created is comin' to your PC! Motor trucks 'n buggies over the most brutal southland terrain ever seen in a racing game. Whether you're just a good ol' boy out for a Sunday drive or want to compete head-to-head against those other rednecks in championship mode, you've never seen anything that compares to Off-Road + Redneck Racing!

Rip it up on six different terrains from the Everlastin' Everglades to the Crushin' Colorado Highlands!

Features:

- Sixteen different vehicle types including jeeps, pick-up trucks, off-road beetles and dune buggies!
- Amazin' Appalache soundtrack!
- Upgrade your vehicles for better acceleration and handlin'!
- Neither rain nor snow nor the Sheriff himself can stop these mud machines!
- Drive through dozens of different weather conditions and day and night environments!
- LAN Multi-Player allows for four to six racers to engage in frantic action-packed competitions!

Both games originally developed by Rage Software. Published by Funbox Media, LTD and Jordan Freeman Group, LLC (DBA: ZOOM Platform). © 2021 Funbox Media, LTD and Jordan Freeman Group, LLC (DBA: ZOOM Platform) – All Rights Reserved.
